title: Always back up first
briefing: Rule one of touching anything important: make a copy first.
You're about to edit a config. Back it up so a mistake can't hurt you.
tips: `cp SOURCE DEST` copies a file. The original stays put.
objective: Make a backup of app.conf named app.conf.bak, in the same directory.
hints: You want a second copy of the file, not to move it. There's a two-letter command for that.
`cp` copies: `cp <source> <destination>`. The source stays where it is.
explanation: `cp source dest` duplicates a file; the original is untouched. Backing up before editing is a habit that will save you more times than you can count. To copy a whole directory, add -r: `cp -r site site-backup`.
